an8.40:1.1: “Monks, the taking of life—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:1.2: The slightest of all the results coming from the taking of life is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to a short life span.
an8.40:2.1: “Stealing—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:2.2: The slightest of all the results coming from stealing is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to the loss of one’s wealth.
an8.40:3.1: “Sexual misconduct—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:3.2: The slightest of all the results coming from sexual misconduct is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to rivalry & revenge.
an8.40:4.1: “Lying—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:4.2: The slightest of all the results coming from lying is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to being falsely accused.
an8.40:5.1: “Divisive speech—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:5.2: The slightest of all the results coming from divisive speech is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to the breaking of one’s friendships.
an8.40:6.1: “Harsh speech—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:6.2: The slightest of all the results coming from harsh speech is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to unappealing sounds.
an8.40:7.1: “Idle chatter—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:7.2: The slightest of all the results coming from idle chatter is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to words that aren’t worth taking to heart.
an8.40:8.1: “The drinking of fermented & distilled liquors—when indulged in, developed, & pursued—is something that leads to hell, leads to rebirth as a common animal, leads to the realm of the hungry ghosts.
an8.40:8.2: The slightest of all the results coming from drinking fermented & distilled liquors is that, when one becomes a human being, it leads to mental derangement.”
